subject.title: fix(openai): align auth availability with effective routes

question: Should this PR's provider route-resolution and harness compatibility types become the supported permanent Plugin SDK boundary?
rationale: The implementation fixes a real correctness problem but also creates a long-term external compatibility promise and changes implicit OpenAI runtime selection; only maintainer intent can accept that product/API direction.

options.title: Approve after repairs
options.body: Accept the new route and harness API as the canonical extension boundary after all exact-head failures are fixed and hosted validation passes.

options.title: Internalize route policy
options.body: Keep provider-owned OpenAI route behavior while removing or narrowing the external Plugin SDK promise.

options.title: Narrow the correction
options.body: Land only the canonical OpenAI route/auth fix and defer the general provider-route API design.

recommendation.title: Approve after repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the new route and harness API as the canonical extension boundary after all exact-head failures are fixed and hosted validation passes.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest evidenced connection to the current OpenAI routing and availability design and is best positioned to decide its permanent public boundary.
